description: Baugher states flatly that 79-0357 is on display at the Vermont ANG airpark Burlington. An OSM way named "F16 Vermont Air National Guard" in the current extract sits at 44.47678 -73.14514 - east of the old airpark row - consistent with Aerial Visuals' note that the display was struck and rebuilt at a new base entrance. This is the only Burlington airframe with 2020s evidence.
museum_name: Vermont Air National Guard Base Airpark

description: Baugher: remanufactured by Beech from AT-7 42-2479; civil N9596Z then N128VC then N128V withdrawn from use 16 April 1990; on display at Vermont ANG Base Burlington. Listed by Aerial Visuals at the old airpark row. Presence after the airpark was struck is unconfirmed.
museum_name: Vermont Air National Guard Base Airpark

description: Listed by Aerial Visuals in the old Burlington airpark row at 44.47538 -73.15110. Baugher's 1949 page carries no disposition line reachable in any archived copy. Serial passes an FY49 F-94A block check. Presence after the airpark was struck is unconfirmed.
museum_name: Vermont Air National Guard Base Airpark

description: Baugher: to MASDC 21 June 1977 then put on display at Vermont ANG Base Burlington painted as 29734 - a false marking that has caused this airframe to be confused with the Barnes T-33 52-9734. Presence after the airpark was struck is unconfirmed.
museum_name: Vermont Air National Guard Base Airpark

description: Baugher: 52-1500 converted to EB-57B testbed; served the 4677th DSES then the Kansas ANG 117th DSES and the Vermont ANG 134th DSES; preserved at Vermont ANG Base Burlington. Aerial Visuals fixes it at 44.47498 -73.15060. Presence after the airpark was struck is unconfirmed.
museum_name: Vermont Air National Guard Base Airpark
